title: NF-kappaB/NLRP3 inflammasome is associated with formaldehyde-induced reproductive and metabolic dysfunction: protective role of quercetin in rats.
authors: Banerjee, Arnab; Roy, Jayati; Banerjee, Arnab; Banerjee, Aditi; Datta, Puja; Das, Debasmita; Paul, Rajarshi; Sarkar, Diptendu; Halder, Arindom; Manna, Krishnendu; Mukherjee, Sandip; Maji, Bithin Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲醛诱导大鼠代谢与生殖毒性的NF-kappaB/NLRP3炎症通路及槲皮素保护作用，仅涉及蛋白-小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Environmental pollutants, including common industrial chemicals, have been associated with global declines in male reproductive health. However, the relationships with formaldehyde (F) exposure, metabolic imbalance, and testicular impairment are still unknown. This study hypothesized that subchronic formaldehyde exposure triggers the NF-kappaB/NLRP3 inflammasome cascade to promote both metabolic and reproductive damage and that such effects can be attenuated by the flavonoid quercettin. METHODS AND RESULTS: In a male rat model (n = 8) of subchronic F (3% formaldehyde/day intraperitoneally at a dose of 15 mg/kg body weight for 21 days) treatment, with or without quercetin (dissolved in 5% DMSO in distilled water at doses of 25, 50, and 100 mg/kg body weight, orally), were given for 21 days along with a normal control group. After the treatment period, metabolic profiling, sperm analysis, hormonal assays, histology, and molecular investigations were determined. Data were analyzed by GraphPad Prism software (version 10.0). Normality was checked with the Shapiro-Wilk test, and one‑way ANOVA was used to compare groups, followed by Tukey's post hoc test. Statistical significance was set at p </= 0.05. F treatment induced significant systemic metabolic dysfunction (increased FBG and HbA1c; decreased insulin), testicular damage (decreased sperm count, viability, motility, as well as testosterone, LH, and FSH concentrations), oxidative stress (increased pro-oxidants and intracellular reactive oxygen species; decreased endogenous antioxidants), fibrosis followed by apoptosis. Mechanistically, F triggers DAMP-associated sterile inflammation via TNF-alpha and TLR4 to promote NF-kappaB and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, while repressing steroidogenic gene expression. Most F-induced alterations were dose-associated and ameliorated by quercetin co-treatment, with the highest dose (100 mg/kg) showing the most significant efficacy. The molecular docking results suggest that the binding affinities of quercetin to TNF, TLR4, NF-kappaB and NLRP3 may be higher than those of F. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides initial evidence that formaldehyde triggers DAMP-associated sterile inflammation with disruption of metabolism and reproduction, and it also demonstrates the potential benefit of quercetin treatment as a nutraceutical against environmental aldehydes by suppressing multitarget pathways.
abstract_zh: 背景：环境污染物，包括常见工业化学品，与全球男性生殖健康下降相关。然而，甲醛（F）暴露、代谢失衡与睾丸损伤之间的关系仍不明确。本研究假设亚慢性甲醛暴露触发NF-kappaB/NLRP3炎症小体级联反应，促进代谢和生殖损伤，且这种效应可被黄酮类化合物槲皮素减弱。方法与结果：在雄性大鼠模型（n = 8）中，亚慢性F处理（3%甲醛/天，腹腔注射，剂量为15 mg/kg体重，持续21天），联合或不联合槲皮素（溶于含5% DMSO的蒸馏水中，剂量为25、50和100 mg/kg体重，口服），给药21天，并设正常对照组。处理期结束后，测定代谢谱、精子分析、激素检测、组织学和分子研究。数据通过GraphPad Prism软件（版本10.0）分析。正态性用Shapiro-Wilk检验检查，组间比较采用单因素方差分析，随后进行Tukey事后检验。统计显著性设定为p </= 0.05。F处理诱导显著的系统性代谢功能障碍（FBG和HbA1c升高；胰岛素降低）、睾丸损伤（精子数量、活力、运动性以及睾酮、LH和FSH浓度降低）、氧化应激（促氧化剂和细胞内活性氧增加；内源性抗氧化剂减少）、纤维化及随后的凋亡。机制上，F通过TNF-alpha和TLR4触发DAMP相关的无菌性炎症，促进NF-kappaB和NLRP3炎症小体激活，同时抑制类固醇生成基因表达。大多数F诱导的改变呈剂量相关性，并通过槲皮素联合处理得到改善，其中最高剂量（100 mg/kg）显示出最显著的功效。分子对接结果表明，槲皮素与TNF、TLR4、NF-kappaB和NLRP3的结合亲和力可能高于F。结论：本研究提供了初步证据，表明甲醛触发DAMP相关的无菌性炎症，伴随代谢和生殖紊乱，并展示了槲皮素作为营养保健品通过抑制多靶点通路对抗环境醛类的潜在益处。
